SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN constructors c ON cr.XCL_012 = c.XCL_022
WHERE c.XCL_025 = 'Japan'
  AND cr.XCL_013 = 0
  AND cr.XCL_011 = 2

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT c.XCL_022
  FROM constructors c
  JOIN constructorResults cr ON cr.XCL_012 = c.XCL_022
  WHERE c.XCL_025 = 'Japanese' AND cr.XCL_013 = 0
  GROUP BY c.XCL_022
  HAVING COUNT(cr.XCL_011) = 2
)
